entities.summary: Līvu Akvaparks is a water park destination in Jūrmala, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A substantial indoor water park that is a meaningful all-weather family destination in the Baltic region. This entry is intended for 5–teen travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
entities.whyWorthwhile: A substantial indoor water park that is a meaningful all-weather family destination in the Baltic region.
